facts.business: Shoppers Stop Limited operates a chain of department stores in India offering premium national and international brands across categories like apparel, beauty, and home, along with loyalty programs and omnichannel retail.

auditor.name: PricewaterhouseCoopers Services LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on non-provision of retrospective service tax levy of Rs 16.60 crores for June 2007 to March 2010 on renting of immovable properties, pending Supreme Court appeal.

key_risks: Change in customer demographic leading to impairment in certain CGUs
Pending indirect tax disputes (Service tax, VAT, Customs, GST)
Liquidity risk from lease liabilities and borrowings
Regulatory changes including New Labour Codes increasing employee benefit provisions
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include Capex reimbursement from Inorbit Malls (Rs 0.93 Cr), Commission on SOR purchases from Global SS Beauty Brands (Rs 36.02 Cr), Margin received on SOR sales (Rs 0.25 Cr), Loan/ICD given to Shoppers Stop.Com (India) Ltd (Rs 13.50 Cr), Payment of variable lease rent to related parties (Rs 6.23 Cr), and remuneration to KMPs including CFO (Rs 4.10 Cr). All transactions are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013.
